components.name: Composer
components.description: Full-width terminal input lane with a Copper prompt and stable focus.
components.css: .ds-composer { display:flex; gap:1ch; align-items:center; padding:10px 0; border-top:1px solid #6f7785; border-bottom:1px solid #6f7785; color:#f4c27a; font:400 15px/1.45 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-composer input { width:100%; color:#e5e7eb; background:transparent; border:0; outline:0; font:inherit; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:#f4c27a; }

components.name: Selected Command
components.description: Explicit picker selection with backing, glyph, command, and description.
components.css: .ds-command { display:grid; grid-template-columns:2ch 14ch 1fr; gap:1ch; padding:7px 10px; color:#f4c27a; background:#3f4652; font:500 14px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-command small { color:#e5e7eb; opacity:.72; } .ds-command:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7ed7c1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Local Model Row
components.description: First-class model discovery row with exact local manifest identity.
components.css: .ds-model { display:grid; grid-template-columns:2ch minmax(24ch,1fr) auto; gap:1ch; padding:8px 10px; color:#e5e7eb; font:500 14px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-model > span:first-child { color:#f4c27a; } .ds-model-meta { color:#7bd88f; } .ds-model:hover { background:#3f4652; } .ds-model:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f4c27a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active Tool
components.description: Compact, unboxed tool activity with the primary argument and elapsed time.
components.css: .ds-tool { display:flex; gap:1ch; align-items:baseline; color:#e5e7eb; font:400 14px/1.45 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-tool > span,.ds-tool strong { color:#f4c27a; } .ds-tool code,.ds-tool small { color:#6f7785; }

components.name: Tool Success
components.description: Finished tool call with a non-color success marker and concise result.
components.css: .ds-success { display:flex; gap:1ch; align-items:baseline; color:#e5e7eb; font:400 14px/1.45 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-success > span,.ds-success strong { color:#7bd88f; } .ds-success code,.ds-success small { color:#6f7785; }

components.name: Permission Prompt
components.description: Bounded, consequential choice with exact target and explicit scope.
components.html:
Allow Bash?git push origin feature/runtime

External write to the remote repository.
components.css: .ds-permission { display:grid; gap:9px; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ff7d7d; border-radius:8px; color:#e5e7eb; font:400 14px/1.45 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-permission strong { color:#ff7d7d; } .ds-permission p { margin:0; color:#6f7785; } .ds-permission button { width:max-content; padding:5px 9px; color:#e5e7eb; background:#3f4652; border:1px solid #6f7785; font:inherit; } .ds-permission button:hover,.ds-permission button:focus-visible { color:#f4c27a; border-color:#f4c27a; outline:0; }

narrative.overview: Morningstar is the terminal developers return to when real work must move. The interface is warm but restrained: a compact identity masthead gives way immediately to the transcript, the active task, and a stable composer. Copper carries identity and active intent; muted terminal neutrals let long sessions remain calm. The layout borrows the clarity of the best agentic coding tools without becoming a Claude Code skin.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous transcript with a fixed interaction point.
Warm Copper identity with Claude-inspired restraint.
Dense enough for experts, quiet enough for long sessions.
Details, tools, and diagnostics collapse until requested.
State is always communicated by a glyph and text, never color alone.
Layout adapts at 60, 80, and 120 terminal columns.

rules.name: The One Warm Voice Rule
rules.body: Copper marks identity and the current action only. If three unrelated regions glow Copper at once, the hierarchy has failed.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Every success, warning, error, and active state includes a glyph or label in addition to color.

rules.name: The Native Cell Rule
rules.body: Never fake a display font, gradient text, or giant ASCII headline. The terminal cell is the type scale.

rules.name: The Flat Transcript Rule
rules.body: Messages and tool calls sit directly in the flow. Never wrap every response, metric, or command in a card.

rules.name: The Boundary Earns a Box Rule
rules.body: A border is justified only when the user must make a contained choice, such as permissions, model selection, session resume, or destructive confirmation.

dos: Do make Copper Glow the single warm voice for identity and current intent.
Do keep transcript content unboxed and reveal depth on demand.
Do show every installed Ollama model directly in model discovery.
Do verify terminal layouts at 60, 80, and 120 columns.
Do pair every color state with a glyph or textual label.
donts: Don't create a Claude Code skin, reuse Anthropic mascots or ASCII art, imitate trademarked product identity, or copy proprietary wording and assets.
Don't turn the terminal into a crowded dashboard or a wall of boxed cards.
Don't use neon cyberpunk styling, decorative gradients, gradient text, or default glassmorphism.
Don't advertise a command, tool, permission mode, or integration unless it is wired end to end.
Don't hide failure, denial, model unavailability, or fallback behind silent substitution.
